PanGuard MCP Proxy — runtime protection for AI agent tool calls

Usage: panguard-mcp-proxy -- <command> [args...]

Examples:
  panguard-mcp-proxy -- npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem /tmp
  panguard-mcp-proxy -- node my-mcp-server.js

In MCP config:
  { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@panguard-ai/panguard-mcp-proxy", "--", "npx", "your-server"] }
